top_claims.claim: At $15.69, Marvin expects 6.3% per year over seven years. Bitmine Immersion Technologies is an Ethereum treasury vehicle holding 5.42 million ETH marked at $10.86 billion (May 31, 2026) against 579.7 million diluted shares after aggressive ATM issuance. Legacy immersion mining is immaterial; staking revenue is growing
We expect **6.3%** per year over 7 years at **~$15.69** on **$-0.02/sh** starting owner cash.
*Primary risk: Continued ATM and private placement issuance dilutes ETH per share faster than the token price appreciates, destroying look-through value even in a rising ETH market.

*Lens failure mode (levered): If issuance pauses and ETH per share stabilizes, the current discount to May 2026 ETH fair value could mean revert; if issuance accelerates, the equity becomes a financing vehicle, not a treasury.

risk_claims.claim: *Primary risk: Continued ATM and private placement issuance dilutes ETH per share faster than the token price appreciates, destroying look-through value even in a rising ETH market.

Mark volatility: Unrealized gains and losses flow through net income ($9.04B loss nine months FY2026), obscuring operating economics and potentially triggering financing covenants or investor fatigue.
